findings.title: Fire reaches inward, then closure denies the outward route
findings.claim: Once the preceding fire has reached the hearts, the closure named here can be read as a one-way confinement: arrival remains possible while departure is sealed.
findings.mechanism: The completed passive closure carried by the focus form meets the legacy wide walk's preceding heart-entry relation, the exact fire-and-closure recurrence in 90:20, and the failed-exit scenes in 5:37 and 22:22. Those contacts change a static closed-state reading into an inward-reaching, outward-denying enclosure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader perceives the final clause as the locking stage of the punishment, with the earlier fire's reach and the later enclosure forming one directional movement.
findings.containment: The focus form establishes closure; the entry-before-exit direction is qualified contextual inference. This does not claim that the focus morphology alone specifies a literal door mechanism or that every fire image shares the same scene.

epistemic.reason: The exact connection targets and trusted publication provide direct wider parallels, while the heart-entry and one-way synthesis comes from a legacy reader walk with attributed, unanchored root detail.
